name: Gotenba Kyouko
source:
[url=/c60783]Yuuma's[/url] classmate. 
Kyouko is a girl who has a peculiar personality and is deeply interested in the occult. She is an engaging conversationalist but tends to digress quickly, often centering the conversation around her hobbies, which is one of her bad habits.
